scope: Paired V11.7 versus V11.8 research on identical supplied real-candle snapshots. Each test is a separate $500 account. All test periods are reviewed history, with no new confirmation trades. No tuning or qualification from this comparison.
correction_decision: Disabled in the default model after mixed forecast accuracy in the fixed initial experiment. The normal report evaluates the trial correction prospectively on identical entries; these error comparisons do not establish another policy return.

rejection_reasons: Fewer than two later test periods made money after costs.
Fewer than 30 trades in the final test period.
The final test did not stay profitable at both ordinary and higher costs.
The uncertainty in final trade results is too large to qualify.
Learning only from selected account trades did not stay profitable at ordinary and higher costs.
This history was already reviewed when this learner was designed. No later prices are available for fresh confirmation.

replay.clock: Historical candles processed without wall-clock waits
replay.daily_context_rule: Only completed UTC days, joined at each signal close. 21 consecutive daily candles required; intraday indicators restart after intraday gaps.
replay.decision_rule: Use only information available at the signal close; enter no earlier than the next candle.
replay.feedback_rule: Learn a trade result only after its exit candle closes.

forecast_calibration.rule: Match strategy parameters, cost burden and raw forecast band. After at least 30 observations and 30 effective samples, apply a shrunk recent mean of actual net return minus raw entry prediction. Corrections can raise or lower estimates. Raw forecasts are stored before entry; unresolved trades never train the correction. Final estimates remain bounded and existing cost, error and risk checks still apply.
forecast_calibration.scope: Residual correction is an experiment, disabled in the default trading model. Chronological development forecast errors do affect the default error margin. Experimental models cannot qualify or load for trading.
